message: `I(<{port}>)` can't sum a flow contribution whose enclosing `if` condition depends on `ddt` ({via})
description: Retired in 2.56.0, in which `I(<port>)` reports the total current through the port, displacement current included, so a condition that depends on `ddt` is kept like any other and this error is no longer raised. Codes are never reused. Until 2.55.x the probe reported conduction current only and dropped a contribution's charge terms; a condition cannot be partly dropped, so one that depended on `ddt` was refused with this code.
actions: Nothing to do on 2.56.0 or later. On 2.55.x or earlier, compute the condition from a `ddt`-free expression, or read the branch current directly instead of probing the port.
